It lists every task in a table and shows the Total Tasks, Open Tasks and Completed Tasks counts. This story covers the unfiltered view only. Filtering, searching and sorting are delivered by a separate story.","business_value":"The user can see the full task list and its totals in one place, without opening each task.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"The user has at least one task stored in the system","when":"The user opens the Task Reporting page without applying any filter","then":"The table shows one row for every stored task"},{"given":"Stored tasks with the statuses Open, In Progress and Completed exist","when":"The Task Reporting page loads","then":"Total Tasks equals the number of all stored tasks, Open Tasks equals the number of tasks with status Open, and Completed Tasks equals the number of tasks with status Completed"},{"given":"No tasks are stored in the system","when":"The Task Reporting page loads","then":"The table has no task rows and Total Tasks, Open Tasks and Completed Tasks each show 0"},{"given":"The report API is called without any filter, search or sort parameters","when":"The API responds successfully","then":"The response contains all stored tasks together with the Total, Open and Completed counts"}],"edge_cases":["The PRD does not say whether tasks with status In Progress count towards Open Tasks. This story assumes they do not; the wording of the metric definition must be confirmed before release.","The PRD does not list which columns the task table shows. The set of columns is an open question.","The PRD does not say whether the table is paginated.
